background_rationale: A chartered management accountant who spent nearly three decades in finance, planning and strategy roles at Conoco and ConocoPhillips, culminating as CFO and head of strategy and commercial.

notable.summary: ConocoPhillips announced O'Brien would become president and CEO on Sept. 1, 2026, with longtime CEO Ryan Lance moving to a transitional executive chair role and Konnie Haynes-Welsh succeeding O'Brien as CFO.
On his appointment, O'Brien said his focus would be to build on the company's momentum, keep raising the bar and unlock greater value across the company.

personal_story.hook: Andy O'Brien joined Conoco in 1997 in finance; 29 years later he became ConocoPhillips' CEO.
personal_story.summary: O'Brien earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of Plymouth in England and qualified as a chartered management accountant. He began his career with Conoco in 1997 and held finance, planning and strategy roles in multiple countries. After joining the executive leadership team in 2022, he oversaw areas ranging from Alaska and international operations to LNG, investor relations and mergers and acquisitions, and served as CFO before succeeding Ryan Lance as CEO on Sept. 1, 2026.
